mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CAR WHERE STATUS = 'Y'

SELECT CAR_NO carNo , CAR_NAME carName , CAR_PLATE carPlate , MAX_PASSENGER maxPassenger , COLOR color , STATUS status , REGISTER_DATE registerDate , CAR_LOCATION carLocation , CAR_BRAND carBrand FROM TB_CAR WHERE STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY REGISTER_DATE DESC

SELECT C.CAR_NO carNo , C.CAR_NAME carName , C.CAR_PLATE carPlate , C.MAX_PASSENGER maxPassenger , C.COLOR color , C.REGISTER_DATE registerDate , C.CAR_LOCATION carLocation , C.CAR_BRAND carBrand , I.IMG_ID imgId , I.ORIGIN_NAME originName , I.CHANGE_NAME changeName , F.FILE_ID AS FILEID , F.ORIGIN_NAME originName , F.CHANGE_NAME changeName FROM TB_CAR C LEFT JOIN TB_CAR_IMG I ON C.CAR_NO = I.CAR_NO AND I.STATUS = 'Y' LEFT JOIN TB_CAR_FILE F ON C.CAR_NO = F.CAR_NO AND F.STATUS = 'Y' WHERE C.STATUS = 'Y' AND C.CAR_NO = #{carNo}
mapper.delete: UPDATE TB_CAR SET STATUS = 'N' WHERE CAR_NO = #{carNo}
